mapper.select: SELECT user_id, pwd, user_sttus_cd, access_limit_yn, login_chk_cnt, pwd_chg_dt, ip FROM msf_user_info WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT U.user_id, U.pwd, U.user_sttus_cd, U.access_limit_yn, U.login_chk_cnt, U.pwd_chg_dt, U.ip FROM msf_user_info U INNER JOIN msf_usr_app_info A ON U.user_id = A.user_id WHERE U.user_id = #{userId} AND A.uuid = #{deviceUuid} AND A.apv_sttus_cd = 'A'
SELECT user_id FROM msf_usr_app_info WHERE uuid = #{deviceUuid} AND apv_sttus_cd = 'A'
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM msf_usr_app_info WHERE uuid = #{deviceUuid} AND bio_login_yn = 'Y' AND apv_sttus_cd = 'A' )
SELECT user_id FROM msf_usr_app_info WHERE uuid = #{deviceUuid} AND bio_login_token = #{bioKey} AND bio_login_yn = 'Y' AND apv_sttus_cd = 'A' LIMIT 1

SELECT user_id, user_nm, mobile_no, agent_cd, shop_cd, ( SELECT apv_sttus_cd FROM msf_usr_app_info WHERE msf_usr_app_info.user_id = msf_user_info.user_id ORDER BY last_access_dt DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 ) AS apv_sttus_cd FROM msf_user_info WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT U.user_id, U.user_nm, U.mobile_no, U.agent_cd, U.shop_cd, A.apv_sttus_cd FROM msf_user_info U LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, apv_sttus_cd FROM msf_usr_app_info WHERE uuid = #{deviceUuid} AND apv_sttus_cd = 'A' ) A ON U.user_id = A.user_id WHERE U.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO msf_user_hst ( user_id, user_nm, pwd, agent_cd, shop_cd, mobile_no, ip, email_adr, email_receive_yn, user_sttus_cd, access_limit_yn, access_limit_dt, login_chk_cnt, pwd_chg_yn, pwd_chg_dt, chg_dt ) SELECT user_id, user_nm, pwd, COALESCE(agent_cd, 'NONE'), shop_cd, mobile_no, ip, email_adr, email_receive_yn, user_sttus_cd, access_limit_yn, access_limit_dt, login_chk_cnt, pwd_chg_yn, pwd_chg_dt, chg_dt FROM msf_user_info WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE msf_user_info SET chg_dt = now(), login_chk_cnt = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
